messages:
Ruth: Quick poll — if you had to pick one sandwich to eat every week for a year, what is it? totally serious.
Evan: PB&J. nostalgic and low risk.
Kai: tuna melt. warm mayo = happiness.
Samir: spicy falafel wrap. can vary toppings, still solid.
Zoe: avocado + egg on sourdough. elegant and reliable.
Ruth: shoutout to dietary constraints — feel free to say "something similar" if you're vegan/halal.
Evan: @Zoe that sounds heavenly. adding it to my weekend brunch list.
snack-bot: Quick poll started: "Weekly Sandwich Choice" — options: PB&J, Tuna Melt, Falafel Wrap, Avocado+Egg, Other. Voting open 12h.
Samir: if "other" wins we need to see evidence (photo or recipe) :camera_with_flash:
Kai: agreed, receipts required.
Zoe: can we make a small office sandwich swap if someone wins? sample taste testing please.
Ruth: love that idea. if we have a winner by Friday, I'll coordinate a snack swap on Monday.
Evan: counts as team bonding. ranked highly on my serotonin index. :salute:
Samir: typing this while thinking about toast. unfortunate.
Ruth: thanks everyone — vote and let's set a date!
